name: Maddox Ranch House Famous "Skinless" Steamed-Fried Chicken & Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Maddox Ranch House (Perry / Brigham City — Hwy 89 to Logan & Bear Lake)
whyItWorks: Maddox's legendary 1949 specialty: fresh chicken with the fatty skin completely removed, lightlydusted and pressure-steamed until fork-tender with far less grease than traditional fried chicken.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Order the Famous Skinless Fried Chicken (white meat breast) with baked or mashed potatoes and warm Maddox rolls; sub soup or applesauce for the raw green salad.
watchOuts: Contains wheat flour dusting and dairy butter
